unsupported: A.W. Hoss & Son, Inc. has operated from Seattle, Washington since its founding in 1936 by A.W. Hoss.
The company continues as a family-run upholstery and fine furniture manufacturer NE in the city's Roosevelt neighborhood.
Clients span hospitality, corporate, institutional, and residential sectors.
The company emphasizes sustainable materials and antique restoration expertise as differentiators.
Craftsmen also specialize in antique repair, hand tufting, and Chesterfield-style work, positioning the shop as a resource for both historic preservation and new custom builds.
